fields.description: The AI Action this labeled case evaluates, e.g. 'deviation_analysis', 'classify_complaint'.
fields.label: Action Code

fields.description: The REAL business record this case's expected labels were taken/derived from (e.g. a real QMS Deviation or QMS Complaint) — never a fabricated record reference.
fields.label: Input Reference

fields.description: Ground-truth category a human reviewer would assign, checked deterministically against the action's real classification output.
fields.label: Expected Category

fields.description: Ground truth is normally the record's OWN real, already-recorded severity value (not fabricated) — used to check whether an independent text-based severity classifier would reproduce it.
fields.label: Expected Severity

fields.description: What the generic expected_secondary_flag/predicted-secondary-flag boolean means for THIS action, e.g. 'capa_likely_needed' (deviation_analysis) or 'is_safety_critical' (classify_complaint). Kept generic/reusable rather than one field per action, mirroring AI Draft's own copilot-agnostic design.
fields.label: Secondary Flag Name

fields.description: Ground-truth value for the secondary_flag_name dimension — used for false-positive/false-negative tracking in AI Evaluation Run (master plan §13.14).
fields.label: Expected Secondary Flag

fields.description: 0 = the input_reference record already existed organically on this platform (labeled with its own real recorded fields). 1 = this case's record was newly seeded specifically for evaluation-set coverage (e.g. a severity/category this platform's real data didn't otherwise exhibit) — still a REAL, persisted record, just authored for this purpose rather than discovered.
fields.label: Is Synthetic
